The Master of Business Administration degree program equips students with essential tools for success in the business world. It caters to working professionals seeking a graduate degree that combines practical training with academic studies. An Executive STEM-MBA is a specialized, high-level business degree tailored for experienced professionals in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics fields. It combines traditional management education with a strong focus on data-driven decision-making, analytics, and technical expertise.

MBA courses focus on strategic management, marketing principles, advanced data analytics, and organizational behavior. Students will apply these skills through projects, case studies, and presentations. Alliant's business school professors, who are working professionals, guide students in developing problem-solving skills and gaining real-world experience. With challenging core courses and hands-on learning, graduates will be well-prepared for successful careers in business.

Hospitality and Management

This concentration offers students opportunities in the growing hospitality industry, particularly in hotels, travel, and tourism. Courses cover emerging aspects of these profitable markets, which are set to grow with innovation and technology. Careers in hospitality are well-paid and offer clear advancement paths, with increasing international demand for professionals.
